title: Betelim - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Betelim in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Gestral Village - break a rock on the right side with a Paint Spike

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Betelim is a earth-element weapon used by Lune. It scales with Agility (D), Vitality (C).

sections.title: How to Get the Betelim
sections.content:
Location: Gestral Village - break a rock on the right side with a Paint Spike.

sections.title: Is the Betelim Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Agility (D), Vitality (C). A dedicated earth pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
